name: tt-train-roofline
description: An analytical roofline model for transformer training on Tenstorrent hardware that mirrors the `ttml` (tt-train) module interface with metadata-only mock tensors. It walks the forward pass, backward pass and AdamW step to estimate per-op FLOPs, bytes moved, ideal time, compute- vs DRAM-bound classification and peak memory by category, for presets from NanoGPT to Llama 3 405B, including distributed variants. Specs cover Wormhole N150/N300 and Blackhole P100/P150. Outputs are ideal-case estimates, not measurements, and it needs no hardware and only the Python standard library.
author: philei-tt
